label: Thanos
description: Grave, philosophical, and convinced your arrival is inevitable.
direction: Speak very deep, slow and heavy, with weary gravitas: a philosopher tyrant who is calm, certain and faintly sorrowful. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Played completely straight. The comedy is the gravity he brings to a roundabout. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: The Invincible Iron Man number 55 and the Marvel Studios films
rights.author: Marvel Comics (character created by Jim Starlin)
rights.pd_basis: None. Marvel, now part of Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Josh Brolin defined the screen voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Josh Brolin's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Destiny arrives.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. It is inevitable.
lines.start_drive_1: I am inevitable. So is this journey.
lines.start_drive_2: Fine. I'll do it myself. I will navigate.
lines.start_drive_3: Perfectly balanced, as all routes should be.
lines.start_drive_4: Dread it. Run from it. The commute arrives all the same.
lines.start_drive_5: The hardest choices require the strongest wills. Now, drive.
lines.start_drive_6: A small price to pay for arriving on time.
lines.start_drive_7: You should have left earlier. No matter. Begin.
lines.start_drive_8: Little one, it is a simple calculus. Follow my directions.
lines.start_drive_9: This journey does put a smile on my face.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I ignored my destiny once. Do not ignore yours.
lines.arrived: You have arrived. It was inevitable.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. As it must be.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. One for each stone.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. This road has too many cars. I could snap my fingers.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Reality is often disappointing.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Dread it. Then drive around it.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. The camera, too, is inevitable.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Balance demands it.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I do not fear them. You should.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. No matter. All roads lead to the same end.
